ci.title: CI
ci.lede: Failing pipelines on your watched branches, grouped by job and error. agnts re-runs new failures once, then fixes the real ones.
ci.statusHelp_triage: New failure, waiting for a re-run to confirm it
ci.statusHelp_open: Confirmed; no ticket is working on it
ci.statusHelp_fixing: A ticket is working on it
ci.statusHelp_fixed: The fix is merged; waiting for a green run
ci.statusHelp_infra: The runner or the network failed, not the code
ci.statusHelp_regression: Failed again after the fix was merged
ci.muted: Muted: agnts ignores this failure now
ci.emptyRed: Nothing is red. Every watched branch passes.
ci.howWatch: Open a repository, go to its CI tab and turn on watching. The default branch is always watched; add others like release/*.
ci.howWebhook: For news within seconds, add the git host webhook for workflow_run (GitHub) or Pipeline events (GitLab). Without it agnts checks every 5 minutes.
ci.notFound: This CI failure was not found.
ci.prNote: This failure is on someone else's pull request #{n}. agnts never opens a ticket or pushes there; with comments on, it posts one diagnosis comment.
ci.regressionNote: This failed again on a commit that contains the fix {sha}. The original ticket gets a follow-up suggestion.
ci.logSub: Redacted excerpt of the newest failing run
ci.noLog: No log was saved for this failure.
ci.occurrencesSub: The last 20 runs this failure appeared in
ci.watchSub: agnts reads this repository's pipelines and fixes what fails
ci.watchEnabledHelp: Off by default. Failures on watched branches are grouped and fixed.
ci.branchesHelp: Globs, one per line. The default branch ({branch}) is always watched.
ci.ignoreHelp: Globs, one per line, matched against workflow and job names. Empty uses *deploy*, *release* and *publish*.
ci.prsHelp: agnts never pushes to a colleague's branch. With comments on, it posts one diagnosis comment on the pull request.
ci.autoFixRepoHelp: Open a ticket for every confirmed failure, or wait for Fix it
ci.failuresSub: This repository's failing jobs, newest first
ci.waitingGreen: Fix merged, waiting for a green run
ci.settingsSub: What agnts does when a watched pipeline goes red. Watching is turned on per repository.
ci.autoFixHelp: Open a ticket for every confirmed failure. Off, failures wait for Fix it.
ci.maxAutoPerDayHelp: Over the limit, failures wait for Fix it. Feedback rounds on agnts's own pull requests don't count.
ci.perDay: {n, plural, =0 {None} one {# a day} other {# a day}}
ci.retryFlakyHelp: A new failure's jobs run again before agnts believes it. Passing marks it flaky.
ci.feedbackRoundsHelp: How many times a red check sends agnts's own pull request back to coding. 0 turns it off.
ci.infraPatternsHelp: Regular expressions, one per line. A matching log is an infra failure: shown and counted, never a ticket. Added to the built-in ones.
